finish.summary: Added a new column at 1,1 with levels 0, 1 and 2, giving the build a level-2 third storey. Stacking directly on the existing 0,0,1 cell is refused (BIN_RIM_IN_JOINT: its bin rim blocks a stacking collar), so the third storey is a new tower beside the caddy. Nothing existing was moved or removed; house rules capOpenFaces and lockJoints applied, check_build clear.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
